The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''25,823 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''10,630 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, a tragedy occurred at the mining colony of [[Ran Dan's Folly]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]], resulting in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of a hundred miners.<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
